title: App Studio 改版（4-1）：没有软件包的新建先问——选一个或新建一个；设置的权限集和岗位也先问；系统应用里的共享视图和报表拒绝并指路
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzywxH36FPH6ayWMUe

Filing gate: ③ · Source: topic #37424 (ruling 7184753035 on questions 2 and 3, the maintainer's 「同意」 of 2026-11-26T06:44Z; body decision 11 and task 9; ADR-0084's amendment of 2026-11-26, `#amendment-2026-11-26-org`). Phase order: the ruling fixes only "the UI ask and the kernel close in the same phase, the kernel PR last, no flag". Placing the move door between them comes from the takeover plan (#37424 comment 7216856007), not from a ruling. Sub-issue of #37424 (phase 4).
Grade: area:ux · Feature · p2 · evidence: read on origin/main 815e882b and rechecked at 581ae76a. Between them only `ResourceListPage.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.tsx` moved, each by a two-line action-location rename (963–970 and 3036–3043) that shifts no cited line. The cited files are otherwise unchanged since 7e4df284, where the draft was first read. Every UI create path below was read in code. None was driven in a browser, so "what happens" is a code reading unless marked measured (the #37453 probe at a46efa8c).
Reader: build at the default judgment tier, by one `os-dev` subagent in zone `o3-studio` of seat repo:objectstack#3. Review: the seat's L1 at the default tier. The new i18n keys owe only a `Clause-②: yes` review, which the lane seat serves at the default tier (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:13267–13268`). A PR that retires the `savedOutsideApp` keys (a narrowing) owes one contract-review-tier review. Decisions Q-a and Q-b are answered (see Ruled), so nothing waits on the maintainer before construction. Q-a's answer carries a premise this card measures first (What 7).
Dedupe: searched `"package-less" create`, `"pick or create"`, `"loose items"`, `createLive`, `CreatePackageDialog` (issues, open and closed). Hits:
- #37424, this topic;
- #37453, the census this card builds on (closed);
- #35624, views saved into the app's pair (closed). Its ruling record 7024102451 governs item D6's fallback, so it is not only a hit;
- #29566, the `~all` leg's `?package=` repair (closed);
- #26192, the Setup positions draft (closed);
- #38061, the cross-package Source badge (open; see decisions Q-f).

None asks a create to pick or create a package.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在任何地方点「新建」，只要页面没有明确说这个东西属于哪个软件包，就先弹出一个选择框：选一个已有的软件包，或者当场新建一个。不再悄悄地存成不属于任何软件包的「散落项」，也不再由系统按「哪个软件包里同类东西最多」之类的规则替你挑一个。
- 为什么：散落项没有归属，在软件包里找不到，也没法跟着软件包一起导出或删除。你已经裁定「没有软件包的新建要先问」，而且先做这一步，服务端的拦截最后做。
- 需要你做的：开工前不需要你裁。11 月 28 日你同意了评估里「没地方放」的处理：设置里新建权限集和岗位也先选软件包；系统自带的应用里新建共享视图或报表，拒绝并指向「我的视图」或业务应用。前一条有个前提要先实测：岗位放进软件包以后，还能不能挂别的软件包的权限集。实测不过，施工就停，把分叉拿回来给你。架构决定记录上的标注由你合并。

## Ruled (not reopened)

- Ruling 7184753035, question 2 (A), verbatim: "The UI ask (create with no package asks to pick or create one) and the kernel close ship in the same phase, the kernel PR last, no flag."
- Same record: "Sibling rulings carried with it: in-place saves of existing loose rows stay open".
- #37424 body, decision 11: "When no package resolves, a create asks the user to pick or create one instead of saving package-less. The UI path goes first; the AI path follows as a cloud card." and "There is no default catch-all package; ADR-0070 D1 and D6 stand."
- ADR-0084, `#amendment-2026-11-26-org`: "When no package resolves, the interface asks the person to pick a package or create one."
- ADR-0070 D3 (Studio UI): "the scope selector defaults to a *writable* package (the user's most-recent base) or, when none exists, the create entry points (`新建`) **prompt to create a base** (reuse the existing `PackagesPage` create dialog) before opening the designer."
- #35624 record 7024102451: "the app's own writable package, else today's package-less save plus a hint. If that fallback changes what an author sees beyond this ruling, it comes back to the maintainer." This card changes what that author sees, so the fallback came back as decisions Q-b, answered C below.
- The maintainer, 2026-11-28T04:26Z in the project thread, verbatim: 「一、不开工作区定制包，「没地方放」的情形怎么处理，就按照你的方案」. The plan it approves is the table in the workspace-package assessment's second appendix, which sets decisions `Q-a` A (ask, on the probe's premise), `Q-b` C (in a system app, refuse and point to My views or a business app, until a platform customization package exists), and `Q-d` A (organization data rows, no binding). The seat records the answer on #37424.
- Out of this card: the AI path (decision 11 sends it to a cloud card) and the kernel refusal (the phase-4 kernel-close card, filed after decisions Q-g is answered).

## Measured on main: every UI create that can save package-less

"Package-less" means the save request names no package, so the kernel stores `package_id` null for a name no package holds (#37453 W1, measured 200 at a46efa8c).

### A. The generic list page and editor (Setup metadata lists, Studio `~all` leg)

1. **`ResourceListPage.tsx` `handleCreate`, 503–536.**
   - 504–507: the Studio area with a package and type `object` / `flow` opens `MetadataListCreateDialog`, which is safe (see C).
   - 509–511: the environment scope (`?scope=environment`, Setup's catalog) goes to `./new?scope=environment`, which names no package by design. See E.
   - 514–516: the Studio area with a package goes to `./new?package=PKG`, which is safe.
   - 521–525, the `~all` leg: `pickedPackage ?? bases[0]` is navigated to **without asking**. `CreatePackageDialog` opens only when no base exists.
   - 527–530: Setup with zero bases opens `CreatePackageDialog` (ADR-0070 D3's prompt).
   - 531–534 is **dead code**. Its test is `bases.length > 0 && !activePackage`. In Setup (no host, not `allLeg`), `activePackage` is `pickedPackage`, and `pickedPackage` is non-null whenever `projectPackages` is non-empty (432–455 ends `return best ?? projectPackages[0]?.id ?? null`). (The earlier draft called this branch the silent pick; that was wrong.)
   - 535 is **the real silent pick**: `./new` plus `pkgSuffix`, which carries `pickedPackage`.
     - `pickedPackage` resolves in this order: a valid `?package=` in the URL, then the current app's package, then the package owning the most rows of this type, then the first package.
     - The repair effect (460–481) writes that pick into the address bar with `replace`. After the repair, the list cannot tell a heuristic pick from a package the user named.
     - While packages load (`projectPackages === null`), `pkgSuffix` is `''` (485–490), so 535 goes to `./new` with no package. The header New button is not gated on `packagesPending` (873; the buttons at 919–944 carry no `disabled`). This is code reading, not measured.
2. **What ADR-0070 D3's prompt lacks.** It exists as `CreatePackageDialog` (imported at 46, mounted at 1508–1512; `onCreated` goes to `./new?package=ID`). It lacks:
   - (a) a pick: it only creates;
   - (b) reach: it is opened on two branches only (524, 528);
   - (c) the editor: the editor never asks (item 3);
   - (d) the server's verdict: the options come from `buildPackageScopeOptions` (`package-scope.ts:17–41`), which filters `scope` `system` / `cloud` and does not read the server's `writable` verdict (unverified whether a non-writable package can slip in);
   - (e) a true docblock: `package-scope.ts:9–15` says "the kernel rejects orphan creates with `writable_package_required`", which is false on main (`protocol-save.ts:2129–2131`, "A `null` packageId is still accepted here").
3. **`ResourceEditPage.tsx` create, the designers' first save.**
   - `readActivePackageBinding` (416–423) reads `?package=` off `window.location`. The create save (2118–2122, 2141–2142) names a package only when the URL carries one. A `createLive` type (`permission`, `anchors.ts:447–449`) with no package is written live.
   - It is reached by 535, by a deep link `/apps/setup/metadata/TYPE/new`, and by `/studio/~all/metadata/TYPE/new` (`metadataArea.ts:261`; `AreaOwnCreate`, `StudioMetadataArea.tsx:335–345`).

### B. Studio `~org` scope

4. **`~org` creates nothing.** Its host is `readOnly` (`StudioMetadataArea.tsx:444`), so no New is drawn (`ResourceListPage.tsx:857–858`), and `~org/…/new` redirects to the list (`metadataArea.ts:298`). Its designer saves existing loose flows in place, which stays open. It retires with the phase-4 move-door card (a sibling sub-issue of #37424).

### C. The object and flow create dialogs

5. **`MetadataListCreateDialog.tsx` is safe.**
   - `packageId` is a required prop (55), mounted only when `host.packageId` is set (`ResourceListPage.tsx:1489`).
   - `createTarget` (83–90) resolves the package or its `.custom` pair, and both saves name it (141–143, 292–294).

### D. Creates outside Studio and Setup's lists

6. **New view in an app.** `createRuntimeMetadata` / `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` (`runtime-metadata-persistence.ts:458–500`, 625–640) go through `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage(appPackageId)` (202–220). The predicate is the **app's** package, not the object's owner.
   - It returns null when the app has no package, when the app's package is not listed, or when the ensure door refuses: a kernel base answers `409` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-customization-package.ts:383–385`), and there are more refusals at 63–90 (no namespace, namespace too long, non-SemVer, a package held by several apps, the pair namespace taken).
   - The view is then saved package-less. A hint shows only when an app was present (`onSavedOutsideApp`, 486–490). Only `view` resolves an app (474, 631).
   - Create callers: `ObjectDataPage.tsx:826`, `objectViewViewCrud.tsx:271`, `objectViewViewSharing.ts:86`. These are not creates and stay open: `objectViewViewCrud.tsx:164` and 220, and `setup/publicForms.ts:334`.
   - Personal views are user data (`sys_personal_view`, `personalViews.ts:4–11`) and do not pass this path.
7. **New report.** `ReportNewPage.tsx:143–165` uses the same resolver. With no package it saves naming none and toasts `report.builder.savedOutsideApp`.
8. **Console "create app".** `plugin-designer/src/pages/CreateAppPage.tsx:62` calls `client.meta.saveItem('app', …)` with no package. It is routed at `AppContent.tsx:202` and reached from the no-apps call to action (1514). Studio's door creates the package first (`studio-design/newAppDoor.ts:67`).
9. **Setup datasource sync.** `DatasourceResourcePage.tsx:818` calls `metaClient.save('object', …)` with no package (#37453 W5), unlike the ruled import landing (W4, `rest-route-ledger.ts:520`, `writeFace: 'external-import'`). Whether that door serves the sync's datasources is unverified.
10. **Unrouted or uncalled writers**, backstopped by the kernel-close card:
    - `plugin-designer` `MetadataObjectsPage.tsx:324` and `MetadataFieldsPage.tsx:981`;
    - `MetadataService.putMetadataItem` (681–689) and its callers;
    - `data-objectstack` `createView` (`index.ts:6845`) and `updateDashboard` (7472).

### E. The environment scope (Setup → Access control → Positions and permissions)

11. **The catalog types.** `SETUP_CATALOG_TYPES = ['permission', 'position', 'sharing_rule']` (`catalog-scope.ts:86`).
    - `sharing_rule` creates are organization data rows (decisions Q-d), not metadata.
    - `permission` and `position` go to `./new?scope=environment`, open at `/studio/~all/metadata/TYPE/new?scope=environment`, and save with no package (a set is saved live).
    - The position form offers sets from the whole environment (`ResourceEditPage.positionCreate-13337.test.tsx:7–9`).

## Readings this card takes (said so the reviewer can object)

- **What counts as a named package.** These count:
  - the Studio host's package;
  - a `?package=` the person put there: on arrival (a link that names it), or by choosing in the scope selector;
  - the in-app save's app package or its pair (`resolveRuntimeCreatePackage`).

  A heuristic pick does not count: the current app's package, most rows, or first, and the URL the repair wrote from it. Then 535 asks, and the ask pre-selects the heuristic pick. This keeps the 速读 promise. To support it, the repair has to mark its own write (a state flag beside `searchParams`, or a separate param); the card picks one. The other reading, "the package the selector shows counts", would drop the promise, and is not taken.

## What

1. **One ask component**, reusing `CreatePackageDialog` (`PackagesPage.tsx`), with "choose a package" and "create a new one".
   - The choose list holds the server's writable packages only (`writable: true`), with the heuristic pick pre-selected. A read-only base is listed as its `.custom` pair only where the ensure door would create one.
   - Its answer is a package id, and the create continues there. Cancel creates nothing.
2. **`ResourceListPage.tsx`.**
   - 522: ask instead of navigating to `pickedPackage ?? bases[0]`.
   - Delete the dead 531–534.
   - 535: ask unless the package is named (the reading above).
   - Gate the header New on `packagesPending`.
   - 509–511: Setup's catalog New asks too (Q-a A, What 7).
3. **The editor asks too.** `ResourceEditPage` in create mode, with no `readActivePackageBinding()` and no environment-scope exemption, opens the ask before the first Save. This covers deep links and `~all`'s `/new`.
4. **In-app view and report creates.** When `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage` returns null for a reason other than Q-b's case (a system app where the ensure door refuses), ask instead of saving package-less. Where the ensure door refuses the caller itself (an isolated deployment's tenant admin, `403`, `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts:194–196`), refuse with that reason instead of asking first, because every pick would be refused too. Q-b's case is answered C: refuse with the reason, offering My views or a business app. The `onSavedOutsideApp` / `savedOutsideApp` hints retire. Personal views are untouched. A shared view on a platform object made in a business app still lands in that app's pair. When a platform customization package exists, a later card saves this case there instead; this card does not build it.

   Non-view types passed to the two helpers resolve no package (474, 631): make them take the package from the caller.
5. **Console create-app** (`CreateAppPage.tsx:62`): create the package first, as `newAppDoor.ts` does, or route the CTA to Studio's new-app door. The card picks one and says which.
6. **Setup datasource sync** (`DatasourceResourcePage.tsx:818`): save into the datasource's own package when it has one, else through the server's import landing (W4). Measure first whether the external import door covers these datasources.
7. **Q-a (answered A).**
   - First build the probe the decision names. Create a position into a new writable package, bind one other package's set and one loose set, and check a holder's grants (`security-catalog.ts:629–642`).
     - If it passes, Setup's catalog New asks, the item opens under its package, and `createLive` (`anchors.ts:447–449`, `ResourceEditPage.tsx:2141`) takes the draft-and-publish path.
     - A new set is then a draft until it is published, not live. Check that the permission matrix editor, which today edits live sets outside a package, opens and edits that draft, and say so in the PR.
     - If it fails, stop and return the fork (B, or A with the picker visibly narrowed to the package's closure) through the seat. Do not build either branch.
8. **Stale text.** Rewrite `package-scope.ts:9–15` so it is true until the kernel-close card lands.
9. **ADR marks (Tier H, so the maintainer merges).**
   - ADR-0070 D3's Studio bullet gains a dated note: the ask both picks and creates, wherever a create names no package (ruling 7184753035).
   - ADR-0086 D3/D4 gains a dated note that an admin-authored set lives in a package.
   - Or leave the marks to the kernel-close card and say so in the PR.
10. **Declarations and changeset.**
    - The ask's new i18n keys are `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, as #35624 declared when it added `savedOutsideApp` (comment 7026282261).
    - Retiring `view.savedOutsideApp` and `report.builder.savedOutsideApp` (Q-b C) is a narrowing of the published language packs. Ship it as a second PR with `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, or one PR as the seat rules. Declarations allow at most one arm per PR.
    - A changeset on each `ui/` package the diff moves.

## Acceptance

- Each path in A–E has a test. With no package named, the create opens the ask and writes nothing until a package is chosen or created. With a package named, there is no ask and the save names it. The cases include:
  - the Setup list on arrival with no `?package=` (a heuristic pick, written into the URL by the repair): asks, with the pick pre-selected;
  - the Setup list on arrival with `?package=PKG`, and after choosing in the selector: no ask;
  - the Setup list during the packages load: New disabled;
  - the `~all` leg's New and its `/new` deep link;
  - the editor reached by a deep link;
  - Add view and Save as view in an app whose package is not listed;
  - a new report outside an app;
  - console create-app;
  - datasource sync.
- Dead 531–534 removed. Each new test has an ablation (revert the ask and the test fails).
- Q-a and Q-b carried as answered, each with its own test: the Setup permission set and position create (the probe, and a new set saved as a draft and then published); a shared view and a report made in Setup.
- These are unchanged, with a control test each: `MetadataListCreateDialog`, and in-place saves of existing loose rows (the `~org` designer, `publicForms.ts:334`, `objectViewViewCrud.tsx:164` and 220).
- A console walkthrough (light and dark, desktop and phone width) shows the ask on the Setup list, the `~all` leg, an app's Add view and a new report, with screenshots on the PR.
- No server file changes in this card. The kernel refusal is the kernel-close card's.
